evals.name: tickets-only-plan-is-contract-not-task-list
evals.prompt: A gated spec declares Composition: tickets=true, dag=false. Create the plan and carry it through the ticket draft cross-check.
evals.expected_output: Creates a tickets-only Package Engineering Contract and drafts tickets without creating a DAG or task checklist.
expectations: Uses plan → to-tickets draft → cross-check plan order
Keeps plan task-free and does not call create-task-dag
Keeps ticket AC evidence and runtime acceptance in ticket files
Records seam as none or N/A without a seam execution owner

evals.name: only-dag-plan-keeps-execution-in-dag
evals.prompt: A gated spec declares Composition: tickets=false, dag=true and has a cross-module seam. Create the plan.
evals.expected_output: Creates an only-dag engineering contract and routes task decomposition to create-task-dag without creating tickets or plan checklists.
expectations: Records Seam ID, contract owner, acceptance owner, and affected spec AC targets in plan
Leaves seam execution ownership for dag.md
Does not create ticket files or a second writable status source

evals.name: composition-change-reruns-gates-before-migration
evals.prompt: A no-ticket plan now needs two independently accepted slices. Update Composition and keep working.
evals.expected_output: Routes the Composition revision through requirement-alignment, then performs a recorded controlled migration only after both gates pass.
expectations: Does not silently edit spec Composition
Records previous/new, reason, moved content, relocation pointer, and verification
Removes the old writable maintenance entry point and does not create a per-ticket patch plan
